t: You're standing at the site of the old Walsingham House, a hotel at 150 to 154 Piccadilly, where The Ritz stands now. The Ritz's financial backers bought it, along with the neighbouring Bath Hotel, and demolished it, judging the fairly new building too inelegant. Demolition also let Piccadilly be widened. Frances Seymour, later Duchess of Somerset, was born on this spot in 1599. Her father was Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex, Elizabeth the First's favourite, who was executed for treason in 1601. She became the second wife of the Duke of Somerset and mother of his seven children.
